hivos.t2: Hivos is an international development organization guided by humanist values that works toward more just, inclusive, and sustainable societies, where everyone has equal access to rights, opportunities, and resources.
hivos.t3: Futuros Urbanos is an initiative that works at the intersection of urban food systems, youth well-being, and climate action. The program operates in 10 mid-sized cities across five countries and collaborates with local partners—especially young people and women—to promote food systems that are more inclusive, climate-resilient, and sustainable.
hivos.t5: The program needed to establish a comprehensive communication strategy capable of articulating the lessons learned and results generated across different regions, while also adapting to diverse regional contexts.
hivos.t7: The most effective communication strategies connect a global vision with local realities. When the stories of young leaders are backed by evidence and data, local experiences can become narratives capable of driving change on a larger scale.
hivos.t8: Listening to young people and strengthening urban food systems is also a way to build fairer, more sustainable, and more resilient cities.
hivos.t9: The most effective communication strategies bridge the gap between global vision and local realities
